text:
Noah P: Day 3 check-in — made progress but hit a couple blockers. Got kube creds and the local inference runtime building (thanks @Joanna). Pre-commit linter failing on `black`/`flake8` for the starter repo (errors below). Also my laptop is prompting for 2FA on pushing forks, so I can't open PR from my branch. PR I was trying to push: #342 (small fix to model loader).

Joanna R: nice! for the linter run `poetry run black . && poetry run flake8` — we have a husky hook that should auto-format but sometimes the env has different python path. Also check `.python-version`.

Noah P: ran `poetry run black .` — still one `E501` line length left. will split. 2FA popup looks like macOS keychain prompt for `git-credential-osxkeychain` — haven't seen it before.

Mike L: I can take a quick pass on #342 this afternoon. If you can't push from your machine, you can push to a created branch on the upstream repo if you have write access, or I can fork and push the commit for you. Which do you prefer? :slightly_smiling_face:

Noah P: thanks Mike — I don't have write on the infra-starter repo. Either works. If you can push a branch with the change and open the PR, that'd unblock me.

Joanna R: re: 2FA popup — try `git config --global credential.helper cache` temporarily to bypass the keychain prompt, or we can add an SSH key to your IDP. If you're still blocked ping me and I can do a quick Zoom.

Noah P: tried `credential.helper cache` and it suppressed the prompt but pushes still fail with `fatal: could not read Username for 'https://github.com': device not configured`. I think corp SSO is complaining. Filing a ticket with IT now.

infra-bot: Deploy check complete for onboarding-starter — image build passed (tag: onboarding/1787654321). No infra incidents detected.

Eva S: quick heads up — onboarding session on private networks at 4pm (calendar invite sent). we'll cover secrets manager and how to rotate local dev creds. Good timing given the git/SAML issue.

Mike L: I'll fork and open a PR for #342 in ~30m and tag you, Noah. Also add a tiny note in the PR description about why the `flake8` ignore was tightened earlier.

Noah P: awesome, thanks. Today list: finish splitting long lines, follow up with IT on SSO, join 4pm secrets session. Blockers: push/SAML until IT confirms.

Joanna R: one more small thing — run `./scripts/setup-dev.sh` to ensure the linter hook installs. That fixed it for me on M1.

Noah P: running that now, will report back if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
